text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —The wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Faintly, powerfully, serenely.
Sharply, quietly, wildly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the seas, the earth, the skies,
and perhaps even crossing time itself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Far, far into the distance—
Swiftly, swiftly, swiftly."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And boundlessly, freely.
(――WOOOAAAHHH――)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Will the lead change?! Will it change?! It changed!!
She makes the pass right here—!!"
(Waaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A winning time of 1 minute 35.3 seconds!!
The horse girl who claimed 1st place in the Mile Championship is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... that's right.
Yearning for the wind, longing for the wind, and then, I――)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
With all this cheering, I really—hm?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Wh... What should I do to become one?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What must I do to become like you...!?
To become a wind that is strong, free,
and faster than anything else...?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...!
You're—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
If there's something you want to be, come with me.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To Tracen Academy.
—To the Twinkle Series!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*... *phew*.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(――Calm this morning.
The morning dew is silver. Clouds to the northwest, slightly thick.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Yearning for the wind, longing for the wind... encountering the wind. And so, here I have arrived.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Right here, starting from now, sprinting forth, I will—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Become... the wind——!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah— Whew.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(My legs... are light.
The earth danced, and the scenery flew by.)
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good morning.
You're up early this morning too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Good morning,
Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(K.S. Miracle-san...
She debuted in the same class as me,
and she feels like a gentle, fragrant breeze—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "You're up quite early as well... The morning is calm, but did a gust of wind stir within your heart?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The heart's... Fufu, perhaps so.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I woke up a little earlier than usual. When I came out for a run—you were here."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even through the morning mist, I knew it was you right away.
Because you really do run just like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that is... a refreshing breeze.
Thank you, Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ? ...Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Not yet.
Not yet, not yet, not yet...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Faster, stronger...
I have to... sharpen my senses even more.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Otherwise—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The "Emperor of the Mile" whom I saw that day and came to deeply admire—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There is no way... I can reach that wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I am still far from achieving the ideal gust of wind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...Yeah, sorry.
I was being thoughtless.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it.
More importantly... would you like to run together, if it's alright with you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Sunset is still a ways off.
In the morning calm, let us become a whirlwind kicking up the turf together.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Are you sure? Yeah, I'd love to!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oops, that's right—before that, just one thing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to congratulate you.
—Congratulations, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The date for your debut race is set, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Once again...
I look forward to working with you starting today, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Good to be working with you, Zephyr!
Yeah. Looking forward to it, Zephyr!

text_block_list.text:
At long last, serious training with Yamanin Zephyr
toward her debut race begins!
"Strong, fast, and free—I will support her with all my might as she strives to become such a 'wind.'"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Right then, let's get straight to it.
Please give me your instructions.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come for the morning breeze to blow—!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

Yamanin Zephyr is usually mild-mannered,
but the moment she steps onto the track, her expression changes.
Her running is sharp and fiercely powerful—!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go for one more!

text_block_list.text: Quietly yet passionately fired up for the main event, Yamanin Zephyr steadily worked through her training regimen.
And—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew—
choice_data_list: Good work. Shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Already?
It's barely even a light air blowing...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: At this rate, won't I fail to become like the gentle spring breeze, leaving my training incomplete?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I do not beckon the wind more,
I can never become the ideal wind—

"To become the wind"—Yamanin Zephyr's pure wish
was all the stronger for its simplicity,
and her drive toward her ideal burned fiercely.

"Still, that is precisely why.
Because I wish to grant that wish together with you—"
choice_data_list: It's okay. Let's pick this up again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
She originally wasn't very strong physically—so much so that she needed to recuperate in nature when she was little.
On top of that, before our contract, her strong will would backfire into recklessness, causing injuries that cost her several opportunities.

—I cannot allow her
to make the same mistake again.
For the sake of her dream, too.
choice_data_list: I'll always be the wind at your back, pushing you forward.
I swear I'll become the wind at your back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry, Trainer.
I... need to have more faith in you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt a truly sincere triumphant breeze.
I shall take my leave for today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you again tomorrow.

And so, our soul-igniting days alongside Yamanin Zephyr began—
reaching for that distant horizon: "to become the wind"!
